messages:
Maria G.: quick async check-in: landed PoC for the microbatch kernel change, still iterating on KV hotpath. did a small perf sweep this morning, numbers below. blockers: need infra to push the new cuda/driver image to stage (pinging @Anika R.).

Jason K.: nice. can you paste the bench commands and output? especially p95 for 1024-token streams.

Maria G.: bench command: `./rbench --model=gptx-small --seq=1024 --concurrency=8 --kv-cache=on --warm=2 --iter=20`

Maria G.: results (local devbox, A100):
```
throughput: 9.6 tokens/s/GPU
p50 latency (per token): 12ms
p95 latency (per token): 28ms
mem: ~28GB
```

Lee T.: those p95 numbers look promising. how does that compare to master?

Maria G.: master (same machine, same binary) p95 ~42ms, so ~33% improvement on the hotpath after the microbatch merge.

Sasha M.: awesome. did you validate correctness of KV reuse across microbatches? any regtests?

Maria G.: added a fast regtest that replays a few prefix sequences and asserts logits are within epsilon. code in my branch `maria/microbatch-kv`. still need a couple unit tests for edge-case eviction.

Anika R.: infra note: holding off on the driver image until next maintenance window (tomorrow 02:00 UTC). if you need earlier, we can try canary on a single node.

Maria G.: canary would be great — want to validate multi-node batching behavior too. @deploy-bot can you create a canary pool with 1 node using image `cuda12-rc`? :pray:

deploy-bot: created canary pool `microbatch-canary-1` (id: cb-1795). will notify when ready. :robot_face:

Jason K.: I'll queue a quick code review, mainly checking locking around KV map and the new microbatch boundary logic.

Maria G.: thanks. left a TODO to add observability tags for per-batch latencies. plan for today: finish edge-case tests, run canary once infra confirms image, then push CR. blocker = infra timing + Jason's review.

Lee T.: lgtm. if Jason's busy I can spare an hour to pair-review.

Sasha M.: also check memory accounting, there was a leak in last iteration. quick grep for `kv_cache.alloc` and matching frees helps.

Maria G.: noted. I'll run leak detector and post results here after canary run. :eyes:

Anika R.: canary pool ready in ~25m, deploy-bot will post status. good luck!

deploy-bot: canary deployment started for cb-1795, image: cuda12-rc, kernel: microbatch-v3. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/cb-1795

Maria G.: perfect. will run full bench and report delta. thanks all.
